## 1. Verdict
Byte-diff against the parent (`tests/fixtures/canonical/out2.srt`, 144 B): exactly ONE differing byte — offset 48, `0x30 -> 0xb0` (xor 0x80), i.e. the second `0` of cue 2's start timestamp `00:00:05,500` corrupted to `0xB0` (cat -A renders it `M-0`). Length identical. This is precisely the documented generation scheme ("bit flips at 8/24-byte strides" — this is the stride-8 family, offset 48; md5 confirms it is a sibling of the committed cargo-fuzz seed `fuzz/corpus/fuzz_sub_srt/seed_srt_flip2.srt` = flip2_008). Mutation lands on the TIMING line, so the parser's malformed-timing path (cue skipped, damage event) is what this member probes.
